card.name: Bibliographic metadata before a text begins
card.fires_on: Small marker words and symbols in citation or page-header lines, such as Abstract, at before a site name, a year digit, or Description. They sit right before the main text or a source note begins.

modes.label: Source line markers
modes.description: The word at after an author credit, just before a site name like sacred-texts.com.
modes.example: Folk-lore of the Holy Land, Moslem, Christian and Jewish, by J. E. Hanauer ,<< at>> sacred-texts.com IN the early

modes.label: Header labels
modes.description: Labels such as Abstract or Description that open a record's summary.
modes.example: Philosophy East and West 46 (2):143-164 (1996) |<<Abstract>>||The origin, content, argumentative

modes.label: Digits and numbering in dates or quotes
modes.description: A digit or number sign inside a date, year, or quote number.
modes.example: 8, 2010 - 20 Million Miles To Earth « Movie Mania | September 29, 201<<0>> - ‘potentially hazardous’ asteroid

card.writes: It pushes toward past-tense verbs like was, did and made, and away from present-tense begins or starts.
card.plain: It marks the catalog or citation header lines of web pages, just before the real text starts.
